about_the_game:
Grab a buddy or three and hit the dock! Voodoo Fishin' takes you into a delightfully eerie puppet swamp, delivering a unique first-person fishing adventure.

Craft your puppet angler with our detailed character creator, then venture solo or with friends into spooky, handcrafted waters. Catch bizarre fish, sell your haul to the Fish Monger (watch out—prices change daily!), and upgrade your gear at the Tackle Shop.

Explore the swamp to uncover secret spots filled with rare fish and hidden surprises. Adventure, friendship, and a dash of voodoo magic await!

content_descriptors.notes: The game features some costuming that suggests tobacco smoking and the consumption of alcohol.  Players can get eaten by monsters

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 or AMD Ryzen 5 1600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 (6GB) or AMD Radeon RX 580 (8GB)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 or 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-9700K or AMD Ryzen 5 5600X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 or AMD Radeon RX 6700 XT (8-12GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 20 GB available space

short_description: Voodoo Fishin' is a first-puppet fishing adventure where friends or lone anglers tackle haunted waters and eerie swamps. Craft your puppet, cast your line, catch rare fish, and upgrade your tackle to reveal what lies beneath the surface.
